integrity: The foundational publication record and the standard canonical equations were checked independently. A complete same-object mathematical preprint was read through its model, boundedness, equilibrium, Lyapunov, and bifurcation sections, and targeted full-text searches found no average, moment, invariant-measure, or conditional statement matching the accepted theorem. A recent full FitzHugh–Nagumo homeostasis article was compared at implication level because it explicitly studies cycle averages. The new conditional laws, variance decompositions, and equality cases were reconstructed from the generator and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures for the autonomous planar FitzHugh–Nagumo oscillator.
It does not treat stochastic forcing, diffusion, delay, or time-dependent input.
The conditional laws fix first conditional moments but not complete conditional distributions or an invariant density.
The equality class includes arbitrary probability mixtures of equilibrium atoms when several equilibria exist.
A differently phrased short stationary-regression observation could remain in unindexed neuroscience or oscillator literature.
title: Exact stationary nullcline regressions and speed-defect budget in FitzHugh–Nagumo
